name: Aura: Turnip Lantern

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Granted by Turnip Lantern

The turnip is held in one hand and sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for 20 feet beyond that. Creatures within the bright light have a +1 status bonus to their AC, saving throws, and Perception checks against unholy creatures.
